title: Sentimental Graffiti: Yakusoku
text:
is a visual novel adventure video game was released for the PlayStation on March 29, 2001 in Japan only, and developed and published by NEC Interchannel. It was later on released for Sega Dreamcast on December 25, 2003, as the part of the series.

A second visual novel, based on the second volume of the story, was to be released as Sentimental Graffiti: Saikai, but was cancelled.
